paper.title_en: Charged Black Holes in Einstein--$U(1)$ Gravity with Letelier--Alencar Cloud of Strings: Thermodynamics and QPO-Based Observational Constraints
paper.abstract_en: In this study, black hole solutions are derived within the framework of Einstein gravity, coupled to a $U(1)$ gauge field in the presence of both the Letelier--Alencar \textit{cloud of strings} and the cosmological constant. Subsequently, the influence of the \textit{cloud of strings} parameters and the electric charge on the structure of the event horizon is investigated. Conserved and thermodynamic quantities associated with these solutions are computed, and their consistency with the first law of black hole thermodynamics is verified. To assess the thermodynamic behavior of the system, the heat capacity and Gibbs potential are derived, thereby enabling an analysis of local and global stability under variations of the relevant parameters. Finally, the parameters of the proposed black hole solution are constrained via a Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) analysis, utilizing observational quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) data derived from stellar-mass, intermediate-mass, and supermassive black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究爱因斯坦-U(1)引力中带有Letelier-Alencar弦云的带电黑洞热力学，并使用QPO数据进行贝叶斯约束，主题相关，方法严谨。
decision.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-U(1)引力中带有Letelier-Alencar弦云的带电黑洞：热力学与基于QPO的观测约束
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，在爱因斯坦引力框架内，耦合U(1)规范场，并存在Letelier-Alencar弦云和宇宙常数的情况下，推导了黑洞解。随后，研究了弦云参数和电荷对事件视界结构的影响。计算了与这些解相关的守恒量和热力学量，并验证了它们与黑洞热力学第一定律的一致性。为了评估系统的热力学行为，推导了热容和吉布斯势，从而能够在相关参数变化下分析局部和全局稳定性。最后，利用从恒星质量、中等质量和超大质量黑洞获得的观测准周期振荡(QPO)数据，通过贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛(MCMC)分析对提出的黑洞解的参数进行了约束。
